summary.method: Deterministic review of pinned public GitHub documentation; no OpenAI API is used. Cross-OS requires explicit documentation of application support for at least two operating systems. CI runners, languages, frameworks, browser access, and inferred portability do not qualify. The remaining repositories are Windows when a complete source scan detects a Windows signal, and Others otherwise. Cross-OS takes precedence; the three groups are mutually exclusive and use the full sample denominator, including ambiguous and undocumented repositories. Windows means a detected signal, not proven Windows-only support. Others means neither cross-OS support nor a qualifying Windows signal demonstrated. Static review, not runtime testing.
